+  Real.exp (-discount*t)*dynamicSurvival t

+    (((hasDerivAt_id t).mul (hasDerivAt_id t)).div_const 2)
+  have raw := exponent.exp
+  convert raw using 1
+  · funext u

+    rw [pow_two]

+    simp only [pow_two]

-    expectedValue 1 1 1=1/2 ∧ expectedValue (1-3/4) 1 0=1/4 ∧

+    (late : 1 ≤ horizon) :
